name: claude-harnesses
description: Curated hooks, skills, MCP recipes, and slash commands for long-running, safe, high-quality Claude Code-driven development.

plugins.name: review-pack
plugins.description: Severity-ranked code review and multi-pass security review with parallel specialist subagents.

plugins.name: pr-guardian-pack
plugins.description: Watch PRs after creation: monitor CI, dispatch fixes via subagents, address review feedback.

plugins.name: tdd-pack
plugins.description: Red-Green-Refactor TDD with subagent context isolation between phases.

plugins.name: safety-pack
plugins.description: Deterministic PreToolUse guards: secret detection, dangerous commands, branch protection, prompt injection, MCP allowlisting.

plugins.name: verification-pack
plugins.description: Verification feedback loop: format/typecheck/test on every edit, and block premature Stop until verify.sh passes.

plugins.name: long-running-pack
plugins.description: Survive context loss across sessions: SessionStart context injection, cost-ceiling guard, large-edit gate, ledger templates, goal-manager workflow.

plugins.name: mcp-pack
plugins.description: Curated .mcp.json recipe for GitHub, Playwright, Context7, Serena, Sequential-Thinking, and Sentry. All servers ship disabled.

plugins.name: meta-pack
plugins.description: Inspect recent Claude Code activity and promote repeated patterns into the smallest useful Skill, subagent, or hook. Read-only investigation; creation gated by user approval.

plugins.name: teaching-pack
plugins.description: Teach the human everything that happened in a session until they can demonstrably explain it, via an incremental checklist and AskUserQuestion quizzes.

plugins.name: full
plugins.description: Umbrella plugin pulling in every functional pack at once.
